newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-GIBBS OMITTED FROM SOUTH AFRICAN SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GIBBS OMITTED FROM SOUTH AFRICAN SQUAD.

text.p: Western Province batsman Herschelle Gibbs has been omitted from a 15-man South African squad to tour Pakistan in October in favour of openers Gary Kirsten and Andrew Hudson.
Both Kirsten and Hudson were dropped from the test team who lost 2-1 to Australia at home.
"Herschelle is not out of the reckoning and I maintain that he will become a significant force in test cricket," said South African convenor of selectors Peter Pollock on Thursday.
"But Pakistan is a tour which calls for experience and Kirsten and Hudson provide that. Andrew in particular has a great record against Pakistan".
Pollock said that the squad had been selected with the three tests in mind and one-day specialists would be flown in for the one-day series.
Pace bowlers Allan Donald and Brett Schultz are likely to leave early to rest ahead of the tour to Australia which follows a fortnight later.
The door will then be open for Gibbs, all- rounder Derek Crookes and paceman Rudi Bryson, who all played in the seven match one-day series against Australia.
Western Province all-rounder Brian McMillan, who missed the one-day series against Australia with a bruised heel, is being asked to fill the problem number three position in the batting order.
"Mac's bowling is a bit of a bonus at this stage of his career and we might well ask Western Province to bat him at number three next season," Pollock said.
"He's a very important member of the squad and we don't want to throw his competitiveness and experience away too soon".

Squad: Hansie Cronje (captain), Gary Kirsten, Adam Bacher, Andrew Hudson, Brian McMillan, Daryll Cullinan, Jacques Kallis, Jonty Rhodes, Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Pat Symcox, Paul Adams, Allan Donald, Lance Klusener, Brett Schultz.
